vendoredComponents.scope: MIT upstream 2D endless core, exact Point/Region geometry and procedural sprites. Playgarden adapter/UI/new SVG modifications are GPL-3.0-only. vendoredComponents.name: Parity complete original 100-level campaign
vendoredComponents.scope: MIT original Parity continuous-cursor arrival +/-1 core and all 100 unchanged original levels (50 ordinary, 50 black/white); 19 first-party editable sources retained verbatim. Playgarden React/UI/storage/undo/hints/new SVG are GPL-3.0-only. jQuery, jQuery UI, TouchSwipe, RequireJS, mixed bundles, upstream binary artwork, social scripts, analytics and remote fonts are excluded from runtime and the six unused bundles are not redistributed.

vendoredComponents.name: Hextris original endless six-direction puzzle
vendoredComponents.scope: Complete original endless Hextris rules, four colors, circular-adjacency flood fill, combo scoring, six wave generators, original difficulty and procedural Canvas geometry. Original and adapted code GPL-3.0-or-later. Native Chinese shell, pure JSON save validation and system fonts replace imported dependencies. Tracking, score upload, ads, remote scripts/fonts, marketing art and all third-party runtime dependencies excluded. Eighteen exact first-party originals are retained in the public source repository for provenance, not loaded by the website. Six unused dependency bundles are excluded from the final source tree; original retrieval hashes remain recorded.

vendoredComponents.name: CAST N, BAMBOO, PARKING original endless games
vendoredComponents.scope: Three complete byte-identical independent original game scripts. Original physics, scoring, difficulty, input-driven replay, pixel characters and procedural geometry preserved. Zero finite levels.

vendoredComponents.name: crisp-game-lib
vendoredComponents.scope: One shared local engine. Explicit RAF/listener/input lifecycle, run identity and read-only snapshots added. Optional theme/capture/rewind/minifier modes rejected; URL loader and debug fetch removed. Gameplay functions unchanged.

vendoredComponents.name: sounds-some-sounds
vendoredComponents.scope: Original generated music and sound effects with one supplied AudioContext and common master gain. Hidden sample-rate context and optional unmanaged-context fallback removed. Exact source bundle retained. No original build scripts/install hooks run.

vendoredComponents.name: jsfx embedded modified waveform synthesizer
vendoredComponents.version: ABA Games vendored source in sounds-some-sounds 2.0.0; license record d35fabbf39b4a6d95c1b3c473f4112dd89905f9c
vendoredComponents.scope: ABA modified jsfx carries Egon Elbre 2017 MIT text and original modification header. Seven fixed dynamic Function oscillators are expanded into exact literal functions, retaining formulas and operation order. Shared noise sample state explicitly declared; unused audio navigation disabled.

vendoredComponents.name: mml-iterator embedded parser and iterator
vendoredComponents.version: 1.1.0 corresponding source verified by full static comparison; historical npm resolution not asserted
vendoredComponents.scope: Six fixed official editable source files and generated class scaffolding correspond to every embedded module, with 65 exact normalized-AST comparisons and all 24 top-level statements accounted for. Shipped mml bytes remain unchanged inside the original pinned audio bundle. Proof and exact transformations are in docs/crisp-mml-correspondence.json and .md. The absent original lockfile limits historical installation provenance, not preferred editable-source correspondence. Existing Nao Yonamine MIT author/template records and full permission text remain unchanged.
